summary: Defines how the Alternate-Marking method is carried in IPv6 packets. It specifies an extension header option that can sit in either the Hop-by-Hop Options header or the Destination Options header, so network operators can passively measure loss and delay inside an IPv6 domain.

eli5.summary: IPv6 packets get a small sticker that says red or blue. Routers along the way read the sticker to count packets and see whether any were lost or slow.
